```markdown
# Marachi Design Alignment Guide

This theme has been aligned with the Marachi "Quiet Luxury" reference design. This document outlines the key features and configuration steps.

## Key Features

### 1. Image-Led Hero
- **Section**: Hero (hero-video.liquid)
- **Configuration**: Enable "Minimal text mode" to hide text overlay
- **Optional**: Add logo overlay image and select position
- **Best Practice**: Use high-quality lifestyle imagery (min 2400px wide)

### 2. Shop By Look
- **Section**: Shop By Look (shop-by-look.liquid)
- **Configuration**: Add 4-6 blocks with portrait images (3:4 aspect ratio)
- **Labels**: Use uppercase, short labels (e.g., MOKA, OLIVE, NUDE)
- **Links**: Link each look to a collection or product page

### 3. Product Grid
- **Section**: Main Collection
- **Configuration**: Set image ratio to "Portrait (2:3)" for full-body shots
- **Optional**: Enable "Show quick add button" for one-click cart adds
- **Best Practice**: Use consistent studio backgrounds for product images

### 4. Editorial Split
- **Section**: Editorial Split
- **Configuration**: Add lifestyle image, eyebrow, heading, body, and CTA
- **Note**: No overlay controls; images display clean and unobstructed
- **CTA**: Automatically includes arrow icon with hover animation

### 5. Lifestyle Fullwidth
- **Section**: Lifestyle Fullwidth
- **Configuration**: Add full-bleed lifestyle image
- **Optional**: Add logo watermark overlay
- **Best Practice**: Use high-resolution images (min 2400px wide)

### 6. Architectural Grid
- **Section**: Architectural Grid
- **Configuration**: Add 2-3 image blocks with optional headings and captions
- **Use Case**: Showcase brand spaces, showrooms, or architectural details

### 7. Footer Newsletter
- **Styling**: Bottom-border-only input with dark subscribe button
- **Configuration**: Edit footer newsletter block in theme settings
- **Best Practice**: Keep copy concise and value-focused

## Launch Checklist

### Content Preparation
- [ ] Prepare hero lifestyle image (2400x1600px min, high quality)
- [ ] Prepare 4-6 Shop By Look portrait images (900x1200px, 3:4 ratio)
- [ ] Prepare product images with full-body shots on clean backgrounds
- [ ] Prepare 2-4 editorial lifestyle images (1200x1600px)
- [ ] Prepare 1-2 full-width lifestyle images (2400x1600px)
- [ ] Prepare architectural/showroom images if using that section
- [ ] Prepare logo overlay images (PNG with transparency, 400px wide)

### Theme Configuration
- [ ] Set hero to minimal text mode
- [ ] Add logo overlay to hero (optional)
- [ ] Configure Shop By Look section with 4 blocks
- [ ] Link Shop By Look items to appropriate collections
- [ ] Set product grid image ratio to "Portrait"
- [ ] Enable quick-add on product grid (optional)
- [ ] Configure 1-2 editorial split sections
- [ ] Add lifestyle fullwidth section between editorial splits
- [ ] Configure architectural grid (optional)
- [ ] Verify footer newsletter styling
- [ ] Test all CTAs and links

### Quality Assurance
- [ ] Test homepage on desktop (1920px, 1440px, 1280px)
- [ ] Test homepage on tablet (768px, 1024px)
- [ ] Test homepage on mobile (375px, 414px)
- [ ] Verify all images load with proper aspect ratios
- [ ] Test quick-add functionality (if enabled)
- [ ] Test newsletter signup form
- [ ] Verify all links and navigation work
- [ ] Check page load performance (aim for <3s)
- [ ] Verify no console errors
- [ ] Test with real product data

### Accessibility
- [ ] Verify all images have alt text
- [ ] Test keyboard navigation
- [ ] Verify color contrast ratios meet WCAG AA standards
- [ ] Test with screen reader (VoiceOver or NVDA)

## Design Tokens Reference

All sections use the existing Hannouch design tokens:

- **Typography**: `--font-heading`, `--font-body`
- **Colors**: `--color-base-text`, `--color-base-bg`
- **Spacing**: `--spacing-2` through `--spacing-10`
- **Letter Spacing**: 0.05em (body), 0.1em (headings)
- **Text Transform**: Uppercase for headings, labels, CTAs

## Support

For questions or issues, refer to the main theme documentation or contact support.
```
